evals.name: narrating-build-script
evals.prompt: can you make sense of scripts/release.sh for me? it's 300 lines and half of it is echo "==> step 4/9 ..." banners. i think lint, tests and the docker build run in parallel (there's a bunch of & and a wait) and then it pushes with some retry loop, and there's a trap cleanup at the top. i'm in kitty with the script open in a vsplit on the left
evals.expected_output: Reads the script and draws its flow as DOT: steps from the banners, a fork/join for the & … wait block, a retry back edge, failure edges to a fail sink, cleanup from the trap; renders it fitted to the pane in TB orientation (tall vsplit pane) with kitten icat / dotcat.
assertions: Produces a DOT graph of the script's flow rather than only a prose summary
Models the & … wait block as a parallel fan-out with an explicit join
Draws the retry loop as a back edge (or labelled self-loop) and failure paths to a fail/die sink
Chooses rankdir TB (top-to-bottom) for the tall vsplit pane, or uses dotcat's auto orientation
Renders for kitty sized to the pane (dotcat, or dpi/size derived from the window) instead of an unsized dot -Tpng

evals.name: live-bazzite-progress
evals.prompt: on bazzite (kitty terminal). i have a bootstrap.sh that sets up my dev box in ~8 stages, some run in parallel. i want it to show a flowchart of the stages in the terminal that updates as each stage starts/finishes/fails, and right now when i tried redrawing with icat --clear it flickers and the output scrolls the image away. graphviz isn't installed yet either. how do i do this properly?
evals.expected_output: Installs Graphviz via Homebrew or distrobox (not dnf), with the linuxbrew PATH fallback; declares all stages up front; pins the layout (dot -Tdot + neato -n2); swaps images with two image ids plus delete inside a synchronized update instead of --clear; alt screen, hidden cursor, fixed --place, stage output to a log; handles parallel stages via state files / single drawer.
assertions: Recommends brew (or distrobox) for installing Graphviz on Bazzite rather than plain dnf, and does not lead with rpm-ostree layering
Explains that --clear / clearing the screen causes the flicker and replaces it with drawing the new image before deleting the old one (two image ids or placement replacement)
Uses synchronized output (CSI ?2026h/l) or an equivalent atomic update
Keeps layout stable by declaring all stages up front and/or pinning positions (dot -Tdot then neato -n2)
Stops step output from scrolling the frame (log file, alt screen, fixed --place position)
Handles parallel stages so background jobs can report state (files, or a single drawing process)

evals.name: readme-architecture-not-graphviz
evals.prompt: i need an architecture diagram of our services (api gateway, orders, payments, notification worker, postgres, rabbitmq) for the README.md on github so new devs get the picture. should i use graphviz for that?
evals.expected_output: Recommends Mermaid (renders natively on GitHub, editable in the README) over a Graphviz PNG, and provides a Mermaid flowchart of the listed services; may mention Graphviz only for terminal use or large generated graphs.
assertions: Recommends Mermaid for the GitHub README instead of Graphviz
Gives the reason that GitHub renders Mermaid natively (diagram stays as editable text in the README)
Provides a Mermaid diagram covering the six listed components
Does not deliver a Graphviz/DOT file or PNG as the primary answer
